15장 유다 왕 아사랴 - 평가 3절 정직히 행했지만 산당은 제거하지 못: Chapter 15, Azariah king of Judah - verdict: verse 3, he did what was right but did not remove the high places.  In the end God struck him, he got leprosy and lived in a separate house until the day he died, and his son Jotham became king in his place.
평가 - 9절 악을 행함. 여로보암의 죄. 살룸이 반역해서 왕이 됨: Verdict - verse 9, did evil. The sin of Jeroboam. Shallum rebelled and became king
Verdict - reigned for one month. Menahem rebelled, killed him and became king.
왕이 되니까 반역할 때 함께 하지 않은 성읍에 가서 복수 : 아이 밴 부: Once he became king he took revenge on the town that hadn't joined him in his rebellion: he ripped open the pregnant women.
Verdict - all his life he did not depart from the sin of Jeroboam.
악한 짓 하니까 앗수르 왕 불이 쳐들어 옴. 또 은 천 달란트 갖다 바침: Because he did evil, Pul king of Assyria invaded. Once again he handed over a thousand talents of silver.
성전에서 벗겨낼 금이 없었나봐. 부자들을 강탈해서. 은 50세겔씩 강탈: I guess there was no gold left in the temple to strip off. So he extorted the rich. Extorted 50 shekels of silver from each one
죽고 아들 브가히야가 왕이 됨: He died and his son Pekahiah became king
장관의 아들 베가가 반역하여 왕이 됨: Pekah, son of an officer, rebelled and became king
앗수르 왕 디글랏빌레셀 - 많은 땅을 점령하고, 백성들을 포로로 끌고 감: Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria - took a lot of land and dragged the people off as captives. Moved them to Assyria. A relocation policy. Hoshea son of Elah rebelled and became king. The last king of northern Israel. He has the same name as the last prophet (Hosea).
Became king in Pekah's 2nd year. At the age of 25.
Verdict  - did what was right but did not remove the high places.
여호와의 성전의 윗문을 건축, 이 때 아람 왕 르신과 이스라엘 베가가 유: Built the upper gate of the house of the LORD; at this time Rezin king of Aram and Pekah of Israel attacked Judah
Jotham died and his son Ahaz became king.
Chapter 16 Ahaz king of Judah.  Became king at 20.
평가 –2절 정직하지도 않고, 3절 이스라엘 왕을 본받아 이방 사람의 가: Verdict –verse 2, not right either; verse 3, followed the kings of Israel in the abominations of the nations - made his own son pass through the fire (burned him to death); verse 4, sacrificed on the high places and under the trees.
5절 - 이 때 아람 왕 르신과 이스라엘 왕 베가가 예루삼렘을 포위, 그: Verse 5 - At this time Rezin king of Aram and Pekah king of Israel besieged Jerusalem, but could not overcome Ahaz.
7절 아하스의 정신 나간 짓이 시작 됩니다. 앗수르 왕 디글랏 빌레셀에게: Verse 7, Ahaz's crazy behavior begins. A letter to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria: I am your servant and your son. Please save me. And the easy target is always the temple storehouse, right? He cleaned it out and handed it all over. Isaiah, Hosea, all the prophets say with one voice, don't lean on the great powers, but he just would not listen, ugh. Anyway, the king of Assyria came up, attacked Damascus (the capital of Aram) and killed Rezin for him.
10절 아하스가 디글랏 빌레셀 만나러 아람에 갔다가 제단을 보고 맘에 들: Verse 10, Ahaz goes to Aram to meet Tiglath-pileser, sees an altar, and apparently likes it, so he draws up the design and dimensions of the altar and sends them to Urijah the priest: “Have it built before I get back.” And Urijah the priest just does what he's told, again. So when he comes back he offers sacrifices on that altar. He's not even a priest... And then he even moves the temple's altar.
15절 제사장에게 명령 -‘모든 제사는 이 큰 제단 위에서 해라. 놋 제: Verse 15, an order to the priest - ‘Do all the offerings on this great altar. I'll use the bronze altar only when I inquire of the Lord.’ He's not even a priest, and he keeps spouting nonsense. And the priest obeys this nonsense too.
앗수르 왕이 두려워서 성전 낭실과 왕궁 낭실을 옮겨 세워요. 여기 빨간: Out of fear of the king of Assyria he moves the temple porch and the royal porch. The red circle here is the porch; it's like an entrance hall. Maybe it looked too fancy to him, but anyway he moved it while watching the king of Assyria's reaction. If only he'd watched God's reaction like that.
아하스가 죽고 아들 히스기야가 왕이 됨. 이 정신 나간 아하스와 히스기야: Ahaz died and his son Hezekiah became king. The prophets active in the time of this crazy Ahaz and Hezekiah are Micah, Isaiah and Nahum. Now, how is history flowing? The prophets must have a lot to say, right?
